items: 【Powerful & Efficient for Business】Powered by a 13th Gen Intel Core i5 and Intel UHD Graphics with shared memory, this laptop handles multitasking, spreadsheets, video calls, and everyday office tasks with smooth, reliable performance.

【Vibrant Touchscreen Display】The Dell Inspiron 15 boasts a 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080) touch screen with anti-glare LED backlighting for sharp visuals and vibrant colors. The slim, sleek design in vibrant black offers a stylish, lightweight laptop for immersive viewing.

【High-Speed Multitasking】Experience top performance with the Dell i5 laptop, featuring Up to 64GB DDR4 RAM and an upgraded PCIe NVMe SSD that’s 15x faster than traditional HDDs. Perfect for seamless multitasking and efficient productivity.

【Secure Windows 11 + Fast Wi-Fi 6 & Multiple Ports 】Stay connected with USB-A 2.0 & 3.2, USB-C 3.2, HDMI 1.4, headset jack, and SD card reader. Windows 11 and Wi-Fi 6 provide secure, high-speed networking perfect for video calls, file transfers, and seamless remote work.

【Complete Accessory Package for Ultimate Convenience】 Alongside the laptop, this package includes a set of valuable accessories to enhance your computing experience. You'll receive a 512GB external hard drive for additional storage, a microfiber cloth for keeping your screen clean and smudge-free, and a hotkey sticker sheet to speed up your workflow.
